info.about: Godzilla: Destroy All Monsters Melee is a fighting game based on Toho's Godzilla franchise.
info.trivia: Announced as a GameCube exclusive, it reached Xbox in 2003 with MechaGodzilla 3, two new stages and a Destruction mode added.
info.why: A remaster rebuilt in Unreal Engine 5 was announced in June 2026 for a November release, sending new players looking for the 2002 GameCube original.
